versions.content: Handling if EthTrcv_MacSecUpdateTxSa is called with Active is set to TRUE , the secured association is disabled and EthTrcvMacSe- cEnabled is available and set to TRUE Status: DRAFT If EthTrcv_MacSecUpdateTxSa is called and the following conditions are valid: • EthTrcvMacSecEnabled is available and set to TRUE of the EthTrcvConfig identified with the given TrcvIdx • the given API parameter Active is set to TRUE • the transmission secured association given with An exists and is disabled then the EthTrcv driver shall perform the following actions: • update the transmission secure association at the PHY that corresponds to the given TrcvIdx by considering the next packet number (see NextPn ) • enable the transmission secure association given with An at this PHY • if another transmission secured association at this PHY is running, then disable this secured association • return with E_OK Otherwise, if the addressed transmission secured association given with An does not exist, return with E_NOT_OK .
